kind: silent captioned screen recording of the built deck and the landing page's ledger section; no audio, no generated imagery

scenes.caption: Classical mathematics. A program checks it, with a witness.
Limitation first: the algorithm is trivial. The offer is the certificate, the refusal and the repair.
Frozen test set. Agreement with our own key is not external validation.
Audit versus self-audit, not collective intelligence. One team, one day.
More agents did not help. A ceiling and a missing arm, stated as such.
Outside use: none observed yet. Nothing deployed.
The ledger on the landing page: every row with its witness, kind, and printed timing caveats.

note: Re-record after every rebuild: the manifest pins the source HEAD, and the deck/site hashes change when numbers change.
